sentences.en: TUTOR: Hello, can help you?
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 你好，有什么可以帮您的？

sentences.en: BRIAN: was told to come here, because I'd like to talk to someone about taking a management course
sentences.zh: BRIAN: 我被告知要来这里，因为我希望和某人谈谈报读一门管理课程的事。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Right
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 好的。

sentences.en: I'm one of the tutors, so should be able to help you
sentences.zh: 我是其中一名导师，应该能帮上您的忙。

sentences.en: BRIAN: Oh, good
sentences.zh: BRIAN: 哦，太好了。

sentences.en: My name's Brian Ardley
sentences.zh: 我叫布莱恩·阿德利。

sentences.en: I've decided to enrol on a part- time management course
sentences.zh: 我已决定报名参加一门兼职管理课程。

sentences.en: A friend of mine took one last year, and recommended it to me
sentences.zh: 我的一位朋友去年修读过这门课，并向我推荐了它。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Right
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 好的。

sentences.en: BRIAN: Is there anything I should do before the course, like reading or anything?
sentences.zh: BRIAN: 在课程开始前，我需要做些什么准备吗？比如阅读之类的？

sentences.en: TUTOR: We prefer to integrate reading with the course, so we don't give out a reading list in advance
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 我们倾向于将阅读内容融入课程之中，因此不会提前提供阅读书目。

sentences.en: But we like people to write a case study, describing an organisation they know
sentences.zh: 但我们希望学员撰写一份案例研究，描述一家自己熟悉的机构。

sentences.en: BRIAN: I've already done that, as my friends told me you wanted one
sentences.zh: BRIAN: 我已经完成了这份案例研究，因为朋友们告诉我你们需要这个。

sentences.en: But would it be possible to sit in on a teaching session, to see what it's like? 021 haven't been a student for quite a while
sentences.zh: 不过，我是否可以旁听一节授课？我想先了解一下课程的实际情形。毕竟我已经很久没有当学生了。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Fine
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 当然可以。

sentences.en: Just let me know which date, and I'll arrange it with the tutor
sentences.zh: 您只需提前告知我具体日期，我会为您与授课导师协调安排。

sentences.en: BRIAN: Now, could I ask you about the college facilities, please?
sentences.zh: BRIAN: 那么，我可以向您咨询一下学院的设施情况吗？

sentences.en: TUTOR: Anything in particular?
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 您对哪方面特别感兴趣？

sentences.en: BRIAN: Well, the course is one day a week, all day, isn't it?
sentences.zh: BRIAN: 嗯，这门课程是每周一天、全天授课，对吧？

sentences.en: So presumably it's possible to buy food?
sentences.zh: 所以，大概是可以购买食物的，对吗？

sentences.en: TUTOR: Yes, the refectory's open all day
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 是的，食堂全天开放。

sentences.en: BRIAN: Does it cater for special diets?
sentences.zh: BRIAN: 食堂能否满足特殊饮食需求？

sentences.en: I have some food allergies
sentences.zh: 我对某些食物过敏。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Provided you warn the refectory in advance, it won't be a problem
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 只要您提前通知食堂，就不会有问题。

sentences.en: BRIAN: Good
sentences.zh: BRIAN: 太好了。

sentences.en: What about facilitics for young children?
sentences.zh: BRIAN: 那么，学院是否有针对幼儿的设施？

sentences.en: I'd like to bring my daughter here while I'm studying
sentences.zh: 我希望学习期间能带女儿一起来。

sentences.en: TUTOR: How old is she?
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 她多大了？

sentences.en: BRIAN: Three
sentences.zh: BRIAN: 三岁。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Then she's cligible to join the nursery, which is supervised by qualified Nursery Nurse
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 那她符合托儿所的入所资格，该托儿所由持证的保育员负责照看。

sentences.en: The waiting list for a place is quite long though, so you ought to apply now
sentences.zh: 不过，托儿所的名额等候名单相当长，因此您现在就应提出申请。

sentences.en: BRIAN: OK
sentences.zh: BRIAN: 好的。

sentences.en: TUTOR: I don't know if our careers advice service would be of any interest to you?
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 我不知道我们的职业咨询服务中心是否会对您有所帮助？

sentences.en: BRIAN: Yes, it might help me decide how to develop my carcer after the course
sentences.zh: BRIAN: 是的，这或许能帮助我确定课程结束后如何规划自己的职业发展。

sentences.en: TUTOR: The centre has a lot of reference materials, and staff qualified to give guidance a on a one-to-one basis
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 该中心拥有大量参考资料，且工作人员均具备资质，可提供一对一指导服务。

sentences.en: BRIAN: noticed a fitness centre next to the college
sentences.zh: BRIAN: 我注意到学院旁边有一座健身中心。

sentences.en: Is that for students?
sentences.zh: 那是供学生使用的吗？

sentences.en: TUTOR: It's open to everyone, but students pay an annual fee that's much less than the general public pay
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 它向所有人开放，但学生缴纳的年费远低于公众所需支付的费用。

sentences.en: BRIAN: And presumably the college library stocks newspapers and journals, as well as books?
sentences.zh: BRIAN: 那么，学院图书馆除了藏书之外，想必也订阅了报纸和期刊，对吧？

sentences.en: TUTOR: Yes, and there's also an audio -visual room, for viewing and listening to videos, cassettes, and so on
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 是的，此外还有一个视听室，用于观看视频、听录音带等。

sentences.en: BRIAN: Is there also access to computers?
sentences.zh: BRIAN: 那里也能使用电脑吗？

sentences.en: TUTOR: Yes, your tutor will need to arrange with the technical support team for 025 C.com you to get a password, so ask him or her about it when you start the course
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 是的，你的导师需要与技术支持团队（025 C.com）协调，为你设置密码；因此，你开始课程时请向他或她咨询此事。

sentences.en: BRIAN: OK
sentences.zh: BRIAN: 好的。

sentences.en: TUTOR: By the way, do you know about our Business Centre?
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 对了，你了解我们的商务中心吗？

sentences.en: BRIAN: No
sentences.zh: BRIAN: 不了解。

sentences.en: What's that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: TUTOR: It's a training resource - a collection of materials for people to study on their own, or use in their own organisations
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 这是一个培训资源中心——汇集了供个人自主学习或在其所在机构中使用的各类资料。

sentences.en: BRIAN: Uhuh
sentences.zh: BRIAN: 嗯。

sentences.en: You mean books and videos?
sentences.zh: 你是说书籍和视频吗？

sentences.en: TUTOR: Yes, and manuals for self-study
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 是的，还有供自学用的手册。

sentences.en: Plus a lot of computer-based materials, so people can work through them at their own speed, and repeat anything they aren't sure about
sentences.zh: 此外还有大量基于计算机的学习材料，使用者可按自己的节奏学习，并能反复练习自己不确定的内容。

sentences.en: And you can hire laptops to use in your own 026/27 home or workplace as well as printers that you can take away
sentences.zh: 你还可以租借笔记本电脑，带回家或工作场所使用；同时也可以租借打印机带走使用。

sentences.en: BRIAN: Does it have anything that I could use to improve my study skills?
sentences.zh: BRIAN: 商务中心有没有能帮助我提升学习技能的资料？

sentences.en: I don't have much idea about report writing, and I'm sure I'll need it on the course
sentences.zh: 我对报告写作几乎一无所知，而我确信课程中会需要用到这项技能。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Oh yes, there's plenty of useful material
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 哦，是的，那里有大量实用资料。

sentences.en: Just ask one of the staff
sentences.zh: 只要向其中一位工作人员咨询即可。

sentences.en: BRIAN: Does the centre cover all the main arcas of business?
sentences.zh: BRIAN: 商务中心是否涵盖所有主要商业领域？

sentences.en: TUTOR: Yes, topics like finance, and of course marketing - that's a popular one. 029 Local managers seem to queue up to borrow the videos!
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 是的，包括财务、当然还有市场营销——这是最受欢迎的主题之一。029 当地经理们似乎都争着排队借阅相关视频！

sentences.en: BRIAN: So it isn't just for students, then?
sentences.zh: BRIAN: 所以它并不仅限于学生使用，对吗？

sentences.en: TUTOR: No, it's for members only, but anyone can join
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 没错，它仅对会员开放，但任何人都可以加入。

sentences.en: BRIAN: How much does it cost?
sentences.zh: BRIAN: 加入费用是多少？

sentences.en: TUTOR: £100 a year for a company, and £50 for an individual, with no discount 030 for students, I'm afraid
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 公司会员年费为100英镑，个人会员年费为50英镑；很抱歉，学生不享受任何折扣。030

sentences.en: BRIAN: That's very helpful
sentences.zh: BRIAN: 这非常有帮助。

sentences.en: Well, I think that's all
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想就这些了。

sentences.en: I'd better go home and fill in the enrolment form
sentences.zh: 我最好回家填写报名表。

sentences.en: Thanks for all your help
sentences.zh: 谢谢您的所有帮助。

sentences.en: TUTOR: You're welcome
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 不客气。

sentences.en: Goodbye
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: BRIAN: Goodbye
sentences.zh: BRIAN: 再见。
